description: Get a checkout link: sign the documents, accept the offer and pay. Needs `bookings:write`. Answers a link for the person to open on DJfindr, signed in as themselves; the act happens only there. Give them the url as it is and do not open it or pass it to anyone. Asking again replaces the link given before. get_link says whether it was used.
